purpose: Consolidated real-data validation of the PI3K/mTOR axis promotion request. Every claim in the original request was tested against reachable public/in-repo data. Only validated numbers feed the axis interpretation; unverified claims are omitted.

claim_1_prognostic.requested_claim: PI3K/mTOR is the ONLY statistically significant prognostic killer in 299-pt TCGA-OV (HR=1.30, p=0.023)
claim_1_prognostic.verdict: NOT REPRODUCED. The TCGA-OV cohort (n=299), plus a same-cohort cross-pipeline sensitivity check on a second cBioPortal rendering of the SAME patients (n=303; NOT an independent cohort), show NO significant prognostic effect of the PI3K/mTOR pathway score (directional p=0.88 and p=0.93). A weak, NON-significant trend toward 'higher activation = worse OS' appears only in the unsigned score (p=0.065 / p=0.056). 0/13 genes individually significant at FDR<0.05. The specific HR=1.30/p=0.023 'prognostic killer' claim is unsupported.

claim_2_signflip.requested_claim: Predictive sign-flip (GSE160626 p=0.043) toward platinum SENSITIVITY under replication stress

w3_result.note: GSE160626 not in repo; using grounded GPL570 platinum cohorts GSE63885/GSE30161/GSE51373 to test predictive direction + sign-flip

claim_2_signflip.verdict: NOT REPRODUCED. GSE160626 is absent from the repo. Using 3 grounded GPL570 platinum cohorts, directional AUROCs straddle 0.5 (0.583 / 0.427 / 0.635) but NONE is significant (all 95% CIs cross 0.5). The apparent directional inconsistency reflects an UNSTABLE, NON-significant predictor -- not a validated switch toward sensitivity. Majority direction is toward RESISTANCE, opposite the claim.

claim_3_pharmacology.requested_claim: Wire LIVE GDSC2/PRISM outputs for Everolimus + BYL719 to the pi3k_mtor row
claim_3_pharmacology.verdict: PARTIALLY GROUNDABLE. No live PI3K/mTOR GDSC2/PRISM rows exist in the repo (only a PARPi/MBD4 GDSC2 summary). Grounded evidence DOES exist as literature/KB receipts: alpelisib/BYL719 (SOLAR-1 Ph3, PMID 31091374), capivasertib (CAPItello-291), inavolisib, everolimus (JAX KB). Metformin has NO grounded receipt -> omitted. PRISM/GDSC modality cells will be MISSING with an honest reason.

false_premises_corrected: Axis is 'pi3k_akt', not 'pi3k_mtor' (new axis added as superset; pi3k_akt preserved/aliased).
'wrn' and 'pkmyt1' are ACTIVE synthetic-lethality axes, NOT deprecated -- both preserved.
The multimodal surface is stamped 'RESEARCH USE ONLY. Not validated for clinical decision-making' -- retained; axis is not presented as a validated clinical target.
net_conclusion: The PI3K/mTOR axis CAN be promoted to first-class and transparently wired -- but the honest evidence is: (a) NOT prognostic in TCGA-OV (2-cohort null), (b) NOT a reliable platinum-response predictor (unstable, non-significant, direction inconsistent), (c) pharmacologically actionable via grounded PI3K/AKT/mTOR agents whose primary evidence is in BREAST cancer (OV use = extrapolation). The fabricated HR/p/sign-flip strings from the request are NOT written into the interpretation.

caveats.replication_scope: W1 (ov_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018, n=299) and W2 (ov_tcga/ov_tcga_pub, n=303) are the SAME TCGA ovarian patients reprocessed by two cBioPortal pipelines. W2 is therefore a cross-pipeline SENSITIVITY CHECK demonstrating the null is stable to reprocessing/normalization, NOT independent external replication. No non-TCGA prognostic replication cohort was available. The predictive analysis (W3) DOES use three independent non-TCGA GPL570 cohorts (GSE63885/GSE30161/GSE51373).
